items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Brown played piano and Brad played the drums.

ctx.x: B-o-l-d-e-n. Brown played piano and Brad played the drums. Trap drums, as they used to call them in those days. And I'm sitting up there with my cornet.
Well, now what were you playing? You were playing sort of popular songs of the day, jazz or what?
